newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix to let more holders sell notes.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix to let more holders sell notes.

text.p: Cyrix Corp said Wednesday it expects to expand the number of security holders allowed to sell notes originally issued in a private placement.

In May, 1996 the company privately placed 5.5 percent convertible subordinated notes due June 1, 2001. Subsequently, it filed a statement registering the resale of the notes and the underlying common stock with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Only beneficial holders specifically named in the prospectus or a supplement thereto are eligible to sell their notes or underlying shares, said the company.
But Cyrix said it intends to file another supplement to the prospectus naming additional selling security holders around March 19.
